meta.notes: Fees exclude 18% GST. 'rates' are ESTIMATED effective return in % (value per Rs 100 spent) at a realistic redemption value; 'base' applies to any category not listed. 'monthly_reward_cap' caps total monthly rewards in Rs where a hard cap exists. 'fee_waiver_spend' is annual spend (Rs) that waives the renewal fee (null = no waiver). 'lounge_value' is a rough annual Rs value of lounge/perks for someone who uses them. Terms change often - always verify on the bank's page before applying.
